memories.content: Apple has not yet confirmed Steve Jobs as the opening keynote speaker for Macworld San Francisco 2007. The company is considering options and may or may not decide to have Jobs deliver the keynote. Apple typically keeps keynote speaker announcements under wraps until close to the event.

Macworld San Francisco 2007 is scheduled to take place from January 8 to January 12, 2007. The opening keynote is typically held on the first day. Apple has not yet publicly announced who will deliver the keynote. The conference organizers and the public are awaiting confirmation.
